You can export your ChatGPT conversations `using OpenAI's built-in data export tool, browser extensions, or manual methods`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF18G55lHsDiiBxJJwvZl1tQN6HtYe1qolIWH0xvXHjstdpdWCbxdzKLNGOmxGU9cKh4s5Pds7qLnb9Yrvr-w52lkG3V_G6OOoTL4_aj8LQPEzT6N3QPE5CVscDOksBRGM8JY60QYtInx3hlw4gNnqgh0jbMdrx3U6h8a5ZAAFQ5DVM3q0pW42BclGLKPmAkhzNP5SNN-idUTHu8qZEU-nRn29jvflAua6nfxcb4rpURoJNlMeJ_t0XtehVbBDm5gpgWrccIapjQWmQYwIxqAcots)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)

### Method 1: Export All Chat History (Official Way)

OpenAI lets you download your entire chat history as a ZIP file containing JSON and HTML files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1zMNYDI_7fnHT2yv0w2aTesNJn2P_ZcSH_MwZD2FmTzqy6sNFtCsJlXOMX-lOjbXaGs_Uqnl5XpVrIazl--SCfQNUelwcKCwG85QzzlC_CVGocmf8qrWd9GvkNwL_QDHr_pV9jLe7o9rf4s7uB8M8w88i5p0hmlpUuvQqVA4EoJvkXTV7QmfqOZL9-8)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)

1. Log in to [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXcEpaET500fRYEKiwQd6DiDmpSoh23BIZ4ygh7-eCblVsr51xYxmt_6xbQ06L4q-8q1ugqDyViDSVwLtCo5FJn9v5q9eUgYDRup6b).
2. Click your **profile icon** in the bottom-left corner.
3. Select **Settings** > **Data controls**.
4. Click **Export** or **Export data** , then confirm the request.
5. Complete any verification prompts (such as a code sent via email or SMS).
6. Wait for an email from OpenAI (this can take anywhere from a few minutes up to 7 days).
7. Click **Download data export** in the email. *Note: The link expires after 24 hours.* 
8. Unzip the downloaded file to view your data, which includes a readable `chat.html` file or raw JSON files.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3QbxZr7J4L4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1zMNYDI_7fnHT2yv0w2aTesNJn2P_ZcSH_MwZD2FmTzqy6sNFtCsJlXOMX-lOjbXaGs_Uqnl5XpVrIazl--SCfQNUelwcKCwG85QzzlC_CVGocmf8qrWd9GvkNwL_QDHr_pV9jLe7o9rf4s7uB8M8w88i5p0hmlpUuvQqVA4EoJvkXTV7QmfqOZL9-8)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXDN6Gertq8mtJdUEttRaIjoHYpGWh5-kWC3CXMr5zccVwyiadq-XfLRpTf2u_t-w7Bro-oxLFA0u_CEx7CaO5FQ1uDRjUQqwp_XbCv_AsdOGAIT2eZ2FI-kkCmb8iVHBmC9wPXDAqD_l2ofdk)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/esX4PAb2rbc)

### Method 2: Export a Single Conversation
If you only need to save or share one specific chat thread:

- **Share a read-only link:** Open the conversation, click the **Share** icon at the top right, and choose **Copy link**.
- **Save as PDF via browser:** Open the conversation, press `Ctrl + P` (Windows) or `Command + P` (Mac), and select **Save as PDF** as your destination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF15U8FEMKB8NlyomT6g8fvMRaXNy5u04CUm3yWcuPd2uO7cKKMHJ19QqLLLYhvIM5z-91NYj7Ey-ct7KkxUSsIfK4ArgyB0ntWDBeeaSBV181RtqD_M6qP_ioOzwTug6dfg7inQDq1gDKbFu7MyS8SGc1OvkYRwCgZi9CUPg_gC3UkXV7sI72t-cjkUmAYj25VFGZM7wK)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

### Method 3: Use Browser Extensions or Scripts
Opinions are mixed on manual methods for large threads, as users on the [OpenAI Community Forum](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF18G55lHsDiiBxJJwvZl1tQN6HtYe1qolIWH0xvXHjstdpdWCbxdzKLNGOmxGU9cKh4s5Pds7qLnb9Yrvr-w52lkG3V_G6OOoTL4_aj8LQPEzT6N3QPE5CVscDOksBRGM8JY60QYtInx3hlw4gNnqgh0jbMdrx3U6h8a5ZAAFQ5DVM3q0pW42BclGLKPmAkhzNP5SNN-idUTHu8qZEU-nRn29jvflAua6nfxcb4rpURoJNlMeJ_t0XtehVbBDm5gpgWrccIapjQWmQYwIxqAcots) note that lengthy threads can become cumbersome to manage. Many users prefer third-party options for more readable formats like Markdown, Word, Notion, or PDF:[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF18G55lHsDiiBxJJwvZl1tQN6HtYe1qolIWH0xvXHjstdpdWCbxdzKLNGOmxGU9cKh4s5Pds7qLnb9Yrvr-w52lkG3V_G6OOoTL4_aj8LQPEzT6N3QPE5CVscDOksBRGM8JY60QYtInx3hlw4gNnqgh0jbMdrx3U6h8a5ZAAFQ5DVM3q0pW42BclGLKPmAkhzNP5SNN-idUTHu8qZEU-nRn29jvflAua6nfxcb4rpURoJNlMeJ_t0XtehVbBDm5gpgWrccIapjQWmQYwIxqAcots)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

- **Chrome Extensions:** Tools like [ExportGPT: Export ChatGPT Conversation](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn) let you one-click export active chats into PDF, Markdown, HTML, or Excel.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)
- **Open Source Scripts:** Developers can use command-line tools or console scripts like the [ChatGPT Conversation Exporter](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXONZTtS5PWla55f80rGnvaj946yYl3ducRZ-3J_g_cI5k6eMrh0RzSAWkhG_hJ10PM2cG2VLBeZUySECIq9ti2FBvJ903mw7fbh2OylN23xDlHG9i-aP8GucbGP6rS7-HpL0F0x6j8NTErBknCbxZuOuaNdKlOUM) to pull full histories directly into local Markdown and JSON files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXONZTtS5PWla55f80rGnvaj946yYl3ducRZ-3J_g_cI5k6eMrh0RzSAWkhG_hJ10PM2cG2VLBeZUySECIq9ti2FBvJ903mw7fbh2OylN23xDlHG9i-aP8GucbGP6rS7-HpL0F0x6j8NTErBknCbxZuOuaNdKlOUM)
